name: Icauna

attributes.attribute: tutelary goddess of the Yonne River in northern France
a river ruled by its tutelary goddess Icauna

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Icauna is a Continental Celtic goddess. To the Celts, both continental and insular, rivers were always goddesses. Such goddesses ruled both the waters and the lands of the watershed. Icauna was the tutelary goddess of the Yonne River in northern France.

okr.objective: Document the Continental Celtic river goddess Icauna.
key_results: Record rivers as goddesses in Celtic belief.
Record Icauna as the tutelary goddess of the Yonne River.
